SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resource_association a JOIN resource_entity p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.id=a.primary_resource_id LEFT JOIN resource_entity e ON e.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND e.id=a.exclusive_resource_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.delete_flag=0 AND (a.shared_type_id=#{typeId} OR p.resource_type=#{typeValue} OR e.resource_type=#{typeValue}))
